summary:
• Claude Code — Anthropic's coding assistant update adds a code policy key, auto‑compact windows and a unified workflow subagent model, cutting latency and context overload.
• Strands Decider — a decision‑model library that picks and scores options in one inference pass, delivering faster results without training data, running efficiently on Apple‑silicon Macs.
• Whirl — an open‑source AI chat app on Next.js and Convex that enables self‑hosted, memory‑aware conversations with search, analytics and tool integrations via API keys.
• celld — Cloudflare’s first‑class Durable Objects implementation for the Deno runtime, providing object‑storage‑only coordination that lets developers self‑host Workers‑style services with built‑in durability.
• Caddy and Comma — AI agents for iMessage and RCS that connect to calendars and email, allowing users to create events or manage to‑dos via text.
